title.zh: 将邦阿西楠省阿辛安市镇与圣玛丽亚市镇的阿辛安-圣玛丽亚桥更名为Narciso Ramos桥的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Asingan-Sta. Maria Bridge in the Municipalities of Asingan and Sta. Maria in the Province of Pangasinan as the Narciso Ramos Bridge
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Asingan-Sta. Maria Bridge in the Municipalities of Asingan and Sta. Maria in the Province of Pangasinan as the Narciso Ramos Bridge
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Cầu Asingan-Sta. Maria tại Tỉnh Pangasinan thành Cầu Narciso Ramos
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อสะพาน Asingan-Sta. Maria ในจังหวัด Pangasinan เป็น สะพาน Narciso Ramos
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Jembatan Asingan-Sta. Maria di Provinsi Pangasinan menjadi Jembatan Narciso Ramos
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Jambatan Asingan-Sta. Maria di Wilayah Pangasinan kepada Jambatan Narciso Ramos

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2001/ra_9030_2001.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Asingan-Sta. Maria Bridge connecting the municipalities of Asingan and Sta. Maria in the Province of Pangasinan is hereby renamed Narciso Ramos Bridge in honor of the late Narciso Ramos as a fitting tribute to a life devoted to public service, for his invaluable contributions to nation-building, and for his inspiring leadership and exemplary statesmanship worthy of admiration and emulation by the present and future generations of Filipinos.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
